senses.gloss: m. (גלל, cmp. גַּל) the stone placed on top of a burial cave, top-stone, contrad. to דּוֹפֵק. Ohol. II, 4; a. fr.—סתימת הַגּ׳ the closing of the tomb with the golel.
units: Erub. 15ᵇ; Succ. 23ᵃ cannot be used ג׳ לקבר for closing up a grave, i.e. if put on top, it is not considered a golel in levitical law, v.
